entries.explanation: Gwadar Port par 13 November 2016 ko CPEC ki pehli connectivity aur tijarati sargarmiyon ka iftitah hua. Port pehle hi 2008 mein operational ho chuka tha; is liye operational hone aur CPEC trade opening ke saal alag hain.

Qaumi Assembly ke sarkari record mein Gwadar Port ke operational hone ka saal 2008 hai. Is ke baad 13 November 2016 ko CPEC connectivity aur trade activities ki iftitahi taqreeb hui; dono tareekhein mukhtalif marahil batati hain.

2017 ke geological paper ne Zealandia ko alag bar-e-azam samajhne ke saboot pesh kiye. Is ka taqreeban 94 feesad hissa samandar ke neeche hai, jabke New Zealand is zameeni mass ke numayan ubhre hue hisson mein shamil hai.

Astola Island Balochistan ke sahil se door Bahira-e-Arab mein waqia hai. Pakistan ne 2017 mein ise apna pehla marine protected area qarar diya; yahan sawal jazeeray ke wajood ka nahi, us ki hifazati haisiyat milne ka hai.

Madras aur Chennai do alag shehar nahi balkay ek hi shehar ke purane aur naye sarkari naam hain. Tamil Nadu ke is dar-ul-hukumat ka naam 1996 mein Chennai rakha gaya; purana Madras naam tareekhi aur idara jati hawalon mein milta hai.

Gwadar pehle Makran zila ka hissa tha aur July 1977 mein ise alag zila qarar diya gaya. Yeh Balochistan ke janub maghribi sahil ka bandargahi shehar hai; zila banne ki tareekh ko port ki baad ki tijarati sargarmiyon se alag rakhein.

Christopher Columbus ki paidaish taqreeban 1451 mein Genoa mein hui. Genoa Italy ke shumal maghrib ka tareekhi bandargahi shehar aur Liguria ka dar-ul-hukumat hai; yahan 1451 andazati saal hai, koi muayyan din ya mahina nahi.

28 June 1914 ko Sarajevo mein Archduke Franz Ferdinand ka qatl hua. Is waqiay ne Europe ke siyasi buhran ko Pehli Jang-e-Azeem ki taraf dhakelne ka foran sabab diya; Sarajevo Bosnia and Herzegovina ka dar-ul-hukumat hai.

Great Barrier Reef Australia ke shumal mashriq mein Queensland ke sahil ke saath Coral Sea mein waqia hai. UNESCO ne is ki ghair mamooli qudrati ahmiyat ki wajah se 1981 mein ise World Heritage List mein shamil kiya.

Waterloo ki jang 18 June 1815 ko hui aur Napoleon ki aakhri fauji shikast bani. Waterloo aaj ke Belgium mein waqia hai; is waqiay ko yaad karte waqt shakhs Napoleon, maqam Waterloo aur saal 1815 ko ek saath jorein.

London Airport ko 1966 mein rasmi taur par Heathrow Airport ka naam diya gaya. Yeh London ka bara bain-ul-aqwami hawai adda hai; 1966 naam tabdeel hone ka saal hai, na ke is baat ka dawa ke hawai adda pehli baar usi saal bana.

Mexico ke Yucatan jazeera numa mein Tulum ke qareeb Sac Actun aur Dos Ojos ki zair-e-aab gharon ka rabta 2018 mein report hua. Us waqt is mushtarka nizam ko sab se bara maloom flooded cave system kaha gaya; yeh 2018 ka record hai.

Vietnam ke shehar Saigon ka sarkari naam 1976 mein Ho Chi Minh City rakha gaya. Yeh Vietnam ka sab se bara aur aham iqtisadi shehar hai; purana naam Saigon aur naya naam Ho Chi Minh City isi shehar ke hawalay hain.

Peter the Great ne 1703 mein Saint Petersburg ki bunyad rakhi aur ise Russia ki maghrib ki taraf khirki banana chaha. Shehar Russia ka aham tareekhi aur saqafati markaz hai aur sabiq shahi dar-ul-hukumat ke taur par bhi yaad kiya jata hai.

March 2015 ki manzoori mein Pakistan ke extended continental shelf ke kuch bahari hudood 350 nautical miles ki had tak tasleem hue. UNCLOS ka Article 76, 200 nautical miles se aage shelf ki scientific submission aur outer limits ke usool deta hai.

2015 mein America ke federal hukm ne pahaar ka naam Mount McKinley se badal kar maqami Alaska Native naam Denali bahal kiya. Alaska ki yeh choti North America ki buland tareen hai; yeh note khaas taur par 2015 ke naam badalne ka waqia batata hai.

Tirich Mir Chitral mein Hindu Kush ki buland tareen choti hai. 1949 ki ibtidai jaiza muhim ke baad Norway aur Britain ki mushtarka muhim ne 1950 mein is ki pehli record shuda kamyab chadhai mukammal ki; jaizay aur summit ke saal alag hain.

Italian muhim ke Achille Compagnoni aur Lino Lacedelli ne 31 July 1954 ko K2 ki pehli kamyab chadhai ki. K2 ko Chogori bhi kaha jata hai; is naam ko Nanga Parbat ke laqab Qatil Pahaar se milana durust nahi.

Sabiq Southern Rhodesia aur Rhodesia ka ilaqa April 1980 mein bain-ul-aqwami taur par tasleem shuda azad Zimbabwe bana. Is liye Rhodesia purana siyasi naam hai, jabke 1980 ke baad azad mulk ki pehchan Zimbabwe hai.

Buda, Pest aur Obuda teen bastiyan thin jinhein 1873 mein rasmi taur par mila kar Budapest banaya gaya. Hungary ke is dar-ul-hukumat se Danube darya guzarta hai aur shehar ke tareekhi hisson ke darmiyan behta hai.

Yemen ka sarkari dar-ul-hukumat Sanaa hai, lekin khana jangi ne hukoomati nashist ko mutasir kiya. Sadr Hadi ne 2015 mein Aden ko aarzi dar-ul-hukumat qarar diya; official capital aur interim capital ke hawalay yahan alag hain.

China ne 1980 mein Shenzhen ko Special Economic Zone yani khaas iqtisadi ilaqay ka darja diya. Shehar apni technology industry ki wajah se China ki Silicon Valley bhi kehlata hai; pehla hawala rasmi iqtisadi haisiyat aur doosra mashhoor laqab hai.

1757 ki Jang-e-Plassey ka maqam Plassey ya Palashi aaj Bharat ke West Bengal ke Nadia zila mein hai. Maidan-e-jang Bhagirathi-Hooghly darya ke kinare tha; saal, maujooda riyasat aur darya isi waqiay ke alag imtihani pehlu hain.

Blaise Pascal ne 1642 mein Pascaline par kaam shuru kiya, jo hisaab mein jama aur tafreeq asaan karti thi. Un ke walid mahsulat ka hisaab karte thay, is liye tax aur accounting calculations mein madad is machine ka bunyadi maqsad tha.

Charles Babbage ne 1822 mein Difference Engine ki tajweez di taa ke hisaabi jadwal mechanical tareeqay se ban sakein. Is mein decimal digits ke liye dantedar gear wheels thay aur machine mechanical jama se kaam karti thi.

Babbage ka 1834 ka Analytical Engine aam maqsad ki programmable machine ka tasawwur tha. Jacquard loom se mutasir ho kar program aur data ke liye punched cards ka mansuba banaya gaya; yeh ek proposed design tha, mukammal computer ki release nahi.

Ada Lovelace ne 1843 mein Luigi Menabrea ke maqalay ka tarjuma karte hue Analytical Engine par tafseeli notes likhe. Bernoulli numbers ka algorithm aur programming ki salahiyat ki wazahat ki wajah se unhein aam tor par pehli computer programmer kaha jata hai.

John Ambrose Fleming ne 1904 mein thermionic diode banaya jis se barqi raw ek simt mein guzar sakti thi. Fleming valve ke do electrodes cathode aur anode hain; diode ka naam isi do-electrode banawat ko samajhne mein madad deta hai.

Computing-Tabulating-Recording Company, yani C-T-R, ne Thomas J. Watson Sr. ki qayadat mein 1924 mein International Business Machines naam apnaya. IBM isi naam ka mukhtasar roop hai aur Big Blue is company ka ghair rasmi laqab hai.

Alan Turing ne 1936 ke maqalay mein universal calculating machine ka nazriyati model pesh kiya. Yeh nazriyati computer science ki bunyad bana; is saal ko kisi tayyar commercial computer ki release ke bajaye machine ke tasawwur se jorein.

John von Neumann ki 1945 ki First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC ne stored-program tasawwur ko mashhoor kiya. Is architecture mein instructions aur data dono memory mein rehte hain, jis se machine ka program badalna mumkin hota hai.

ENIAC aik bare paimanay ka general-purpose electronic numerical computer tha. Jang ke ikhtitam ke qareeb is ki takmeel hui aur February 1946 mein ise awam ke samne pesh kiya gaya; yahan 1946 public unveiling ka saal hai.

December 1947 mein Bell Labs ne working point-contact transistor dikhaya. Vacuum tubes ke muqablay mein yeh chhota, zyada bharosemand aur kam energy istemal karta tha; baad ki second-generation computers mein transistor bunyadi switching device bana.

EDSAC ne May 1949 mein apne pehle programs aur calculations kamyabi se chalaye. Yeh full-scale operational stored-program electronic machine ki aham misaal thi; yahan tareekh ka talluq amli taur par program chalne se hai.

General Motors aur North American Aviation ka GM-NAA I/O 1956 mein IBM 704 ke liye istemal hua. Is batch operating system ne jobs ko automate kiya aur ise amli kaam ke ibtidai operating systems mein shumar kiya jata hai.

John Backus ki qayadat mein IBM ki team ne FORTRAN language aur compiler tayyar kiya. Pehla compiler 1957 mein istemal ke liye diya gaya, jis se high-level scientific programming ko taraqqi mili; shakhs aur release year ko saath yaad rakhein.

Texas Instruments ke Jack Kilby ne 1958 mein pehla working integrated circuit dikhaya. Jack Kilby aur Robert Noyce ne alag alag is ki amli shaklein tayyar ki thin; Noyce ka baad ka planar design aur Kilby ka pehla muzahira alag marahil hain.

Douglas Engelbart ki 1968 ki computer demonstration Mother of All Demos ke naam se mashhoor hai. Is mein mouse, hypertext aur mil kar computer par kaam karne ki technology dikhayi gayi; un ki team ne mouse ka ibtidai lakri ka prototype bhi banaya tha.

1969 mein UCLA aur Stanford Research Institute ke darmiyan ARPANET ka ibtidai host-to-host rabta hua. Pehla paigham LOGIN bhejne ki koshish thi, magar system do haroof LO ke baad ruk gaya; isi liye pehli successful transmission LO thi.

Intel ne 4004 microprocessor 1971 mein commercial taur par pesh kiya; 4004 model number hai, tareekh nahi. Microprocessor mein CPU ke bunyadi afaal aik chip par jama hue, jo conventional fourth-generation computers ki khas pehchan hai.

Ray Tomlinson ne 1971 mein ARPANET ke do networked computers ke darmiyan email bheji, sirf aik machine ke local mailbox mein nahi. Unhon ne user name aur destination host ko alag karne ke liye @ nishan chuna, jo email address ki pehchan bana.

Bill Gates aur Paul Allen ne April 1975 mein Microsoft qaim ki. Company ka ibtidai maqsad personal computers ke liye software banana tha; Microsoft ki bunyad ko us ki baad ki kisi khaas software product ki release se alag samjhein.

Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak aur Ronald Wayne ne 1976 mein Apple Computer ki ibtidai partnership banayi. Isi daur mein Apple I samne aya; company ke teen banion aur us ke qayam ka saal aik hi ibtidai marhalay ke hawalay hain.

Adam Osborne ki company ne 1981 mein Osborne 1 pesh kiya, jo ibtidai kamyab portable microcomputer tha. Is mein 8-bit microprocessor ke saath CP/M software ecosystem istemal hota tha; hardware ka naam Osborne 1 aur operating system CP/M hai.

IBM ne August 1981 mein Model 5150 Personal Computer mutaarif karaya, jis ne PC market par gehra asar dala. Microprocessor ke chhotay size aur kam lagat ne is daur mein ghar aur daftar ke personal computers ko aam karne mein madad di.

Apple Lisa 1983 mein mutaarif hua aur commercial graphical interface ki tareekh mein aham tha. Apple ka original Macintosh January 1984 mein aya; Lisa aur Macintosh aik hi computer nahi aur in ke release years bhi alag hain.

Microsoft ne Windows ka pehla elan 1983 mein kiya, magar pehli retail release Windows 1.0 November 1985 mein market mein ayi. Elan aur software ki users ko dastiyabi do mukhtalif marahil hain; sawal ki wording se sahi saal chunein.

ARPANET ne 1 January 1983 ko TCP/IP par intiqal kiya, jo jadeed Internet ki amli taraqqi ka aham sang-e-meel hai. Is se pehle bhi ARPANET packet switching aur host computers ke rabtay ka nizam tha; 1983 protocol tabdeeli ka saal hai.

Microsoft Word 1.0 ki pehli release 25 October 1983 se mansoob hai. Development ke ibtidai daur mein product ko Multi-Tool Word kaha jata tha, phir Microsoft Word naam apnaya gaya; pehla naam aur release date isi product ki tareekh hain.

Apple ne original Macintosh January 1984 mein pesh kiya, jis mein graphical user interface aur mouse numayan thay. Is se pehle Lisa 1983 mein aa chuka tha; Macintosh ya Mac Apple ki personal-computer product line ka naam hai.

Windows 1.0 Microsoft ki pehli retail Windows release thi jo November 1985 mein dastiyab hui. Windows ka elan 1983 mein ho chuka tha; is liye pehle announcement ke liye 1983 aur pehli release ke liye 1985 durust silsila hai.

Brain virus 1986 mein Lahore, Pakistan se samne aya aur IBM-PC ke boot sectors ko infect karta tha. Is note mein asal nisbat mulk Pakistan, shehar Lahore aur saal 1986 hai; Brain ko computer hardware ke bajaye virus ke taur par pehchanein.

Linus Torvalds ne 1991 mein Linux kernel project shuru kiya aur pehli public release jari ki. Baad mein duniya bhar ki open-source community ne kernel ko wusat di; bunyadi khalik ka naam aur mushtarka baad ki taraqqi alag pehlu hain.

Web ke mojad Tim Berners-Lee ne 1994 mein MIT mein World Wide Web Consortium, yani W3C, qaim kiya. Is ka kaam experts aur member idaron ko jama kar ke khulay Web standards banana aur un ki taraqqi ko hum ahang karna hai.

Jerry Yang aur David Filo ne Stanford mein 1994 mein aik web directory shuru ki. Is ka pehla naam Jerry and David's Guide to the World Wide Web tha, jo baad mein Yahoo bana; yeh ibtida website links ki directory ke taur par hui.

WebCrawler 1994 mein launch hua aur poore web pages ka matn index aur search kar sakta tha. Pehle kai tools mehdood titles ya insani taur par tayyar lists par mabni thay; full-text, full-page search is ki numayan khasusiyat thi.

Jeff Bezos ne Amazon company 1994 mein qaim ki, jabke us ki online bookstore July 1995 mein customers ke liye khuli. Company ki bunyad aur website par tijarat shuru hone ke yeh do alag saal hain, is liye dono ko aik na samjhein.

Jim Clark aur Marc Andreessen ne 1994 mein Mosaic Communications qaim ki, jo baad mein Netscape Communications kehlayi. August 1995 mein company ki pehli public share offering hui; founding aur IPO do alag tijarati marahil hain.

Amazon ki online bookstore July 1995 mein customers ke liye khuli. Jeff Bezos company ki bunyad 1994 mein rakh chuke thay; is liye Amazon founded ka jawab 1994 hai, magar online customers ke liye opening ka jawab 1995 hai.

Netscape ki August 1995 ki initial public offering commercial Internet ke ibtidai daur ka numayan waqia thi. Jim Clark aur Marc Andreessen ne is company ko 1994 mein Mosaic Communications ke naam se qaim kiya tha; IPO company ki bunyad nahi.

Sabeer Bhatia aur Jack Smith ne Hotmail qaim ki thi, jise Microsoft ne 1997 mein hasil kiya. Acquisition ka elan December 1997 mein hua; is liye Hotmail ke banion ke naam aur ise khareedne wali company Microsoft alag pehchan hain.

Larry Page aur Sergey Brin ka Stanford search project pehle BackRub kehlata tha. Unhon ne Google ko 1998 mein company ke taur par qaim kiya; BackRub pehla project name aur Google baad ki company ka naam hai.
Jack Ma ki qayadat mein 18 founders ne 1999 mein China ke shehar Hangzhou mein Alibaba qaim ki. Is waqiay ke char rabtay yaad rakhein: company Alibaba, qayadat Jack Ma, maqam Hangzhou aur saal 1999.

Wikipedia ka public launch 15 January 2001 ko hua aur Jimmy Wales is online encyclopedia ke co-founders mein shamil hain. Sawal mein un ka naam hone ka matlab yeh nahi ke woh wahid bani thay; saal 2001 public launch se mutalliq hai.

Steve Chen, Chad Hurley aur Jawed Karim ne 2005 mein YouTube qaim ki; ibtidai founding group mein teen afrad thay. Agle saal October 2006 mein Google ne ise khareedne ka muahida announce kiya, is liye founding aur acquisition alag waqiat hain.

Twitter 2006 mein chhoti public posts par mabni microblogging service ke taur par shuru hua. Ibtida mein aik text post ki had 140 characters thi, jo SMS daur ke design se mutasir thi; yeh shuruati limit ka hawala hai, har baad ke version ka nahi.

YouTube ki bunyad 2005 mein rakhi gayi thi, jabke Google ne October 2006 mein use khareedne ka agreement announce kiya. Yahan 2006 ownership se mutalliq muahiday ka saal hai; ise YouTube ke pehli baar qaim hone ka saal na samjhein.

Apple ne 2007 mein iPhone ko mobile phone, music player aur Internet device ke imtizaj ke taur par pesh kiya. Apple hi Macintosh computer ki company bhi hai; is sawal mein iPhone product hai aur Apple ise banane wali company.

Luc(as) de Groot ki design ki hui Calibri font family ko Microsoft Office 2007 mein default typeface banaya gaya. Yeh kai aglay releases mein bhi default raha; 2007 ko font ke Office mein default banne ke marhalay se jorein.

Jan Koum aur Brian Acton ne mil kar 2009 mein WhatsApp ki bunyad rakhi. Dono co-founders hain, is liye sirf aik naam ko mukammal founding team na samjhein; is topic mein saal company ke qayam ka hai, kisi baad ki tabdeeli ka nahi.

Kevin Systrom aur Mike Krieger ne 2010 mein Instagram qaim ki. Agar sawal Kevin Systrom ke saath doosray co-founder ka naam poochay to Mike Krieger jawab hai; dono naam isi company ki mushtarka bunyad se mutalliq hain.

Eric Yuan ne 2011 mein Zoom company qaim ki aur company ki tareekh unhein founder ke taur par darj karti hai. Is note mein Zoom company ka naam, Eric Yuan bani aur 2011 qayam ka saal hai; inhein aik hi tareekhi waqiay ke teen pehlu samjhein.

Zhang Yiming ne 2012 mein ByteDance company qaim ki, jis ne baad mein TikTok launch kiya. TikTok ne 2021 mein Shou Zi Chew ko CEO muqarrar kiya; ByteDance ka founder aur TikTok ka CEO do mukhtalif afrad aur zimmedariyan hain.

Digital Rights Foundation ne December 2016 mein Pakistan ki pehli dedicated Cyber Harassment Helpline shuru ki. Is ka maqsad online harassment se mutasir afrad ko support dena tha; helpline ke naam ke saath idara aur launch month bhi yaad rakhein.

2017 ke Attention Is All You Need paper mein Google ke researchers ne recurrent layers ke bajaye attention par mabni Transformer pesh kiya. GPT family Transformer decoder istemal karti hai, jo matn ke mukhtalif hisson ke rabtay model karta hai.

Microsoft ne Excel 2019 ko Office 2019 ke saath 24 September 2018 ko aam istemal ke liye jari kiya. Product ke naam mein 2019 hone ke bawajood asal release 2018 mein hui; version name aur release date ko alag samajhna yahan zaroori hai.

Google+ ko Facebook jaisay social-networking platforms ke muqablay mein pesh kiya gaya tha. Google ne aam users ke consumer Google+ accounts April 2019 mein band kiye; yeh khaas consumer service ki bandish hai, tamam Google products ki nahi.

Windows 11 ki pehli general release October 2021 mein hui, yani software aam users ke liye dastiyab hua. Yeh Windows family ke is major version ka release milestone hai; ise Windows ke ibtidai elan ya Windows 1.0 ki tareekh se alag rakhein.

TikTok ne 2021 mein Shou Zi Chew ko chief executive officer muqarrar karne ka elan kiya. TikTok banane wali ByteDance ke bani Zhang Yiming hain, jinhon ne company 2012 mein qaim ki; CEO aur asal founder ki nisbat yahan alag hai.

OpenAI ne ChatGPT ko 30 November 2022 ko public research preview ke taur par pesh kiya. Introducing ChatGPT ka elan bhi isi tareekh ka hai; 2022 company ki bunyad ka nahi balkay is product ke awaami preview ka saal hai.

Liang Wenfeng ne AI company DeepSeek 2023 mein qaim ki; mutalliq sawal mein is ka headquarters Hangzhou, China hai. Qayam ka saal aur headquarters do alag pehlu hain: pehla company ki ibtida batata hai aur doosra markazi daftar ka shehar.

Galileo ne 1613 ki Letters on Sunspots mein doorbeen se dekhe gaye suraj ke dhabbay bayan kiye. Dhabbay ki harkat aur badalti shakl se samajh aya ke yeh suraj se wabasta mazahir hain, us ke samne ghoomte mustaqil sayyaray nahi.

William Harvey ki kitab De Motu Cordis 1628 mein shaya hui. Unhon ne tajribaat se wazeh kiya ke dil khoon pump karta hai aur khoon jism mein musalsal gardish karta hai; is kaam ne jadeed physiology aur dil ki tib ki bunyad mazboot ki.

Edward Jenner ne May 1796 mein aath sala James Phipps ko cowpox material de kar smallpox se bachao ka tajriba kiya. Cowpox istemal hone wali janwari bimari thi aur smallpox woh bimari thi jis ke khilaf hifazat maqsad tha.

Alfred Russel Wallace ne Darwin se alag kaam karte hue natural selection ka bunyadi khayal hasil kiya. 1858 mein dono ki tehreerain Linnean Society mein mushtarka pesh huin; Darwin ki On the Origin of Species aglay saal 1859 mein shaya hui.

Mendeleev ne 1869 mein maloom anasir ko khasusiyat ke namoonon ke mutabiq munazzam kiya aur khali jaghon ke anasir ki peshgoi ki. Jadeed periodic table barhte atomic number, yani nucleus mein protons ki tadaad, ke mutabiq tartib di jati hai.

Alexander Graham Bell ko telephone design ka mashhoor U.S. Patent No. 174,465, 7 March 1876 ko jari hua. Yahan 174,465 patent number hai, saal nahi; shakhs Bell, ijad telephone aur tareekh March 1876 ko alag pehchanein.

Jaime Ferran ki insani cholera vaccine 1885 mein Spain ki bare paimanay ki vaccination muhim mein istemal hui. Isay Pasteur ki murghiyon wali fowl-cholera vaccine ya Jenner ke 1796 smallpox tajribay se na milayein; bimari aur istemal alag thay.

Karl Benz ne apni teen pahiyon wali Benz Patent-Motorwagen ka patent 1886 mein hasil kiya. Yeh internal-combustion engine se chalne wali pehli amli petrol automobiles mein bunyadi maqam rakhti hai; 1886 is mashhoor patent ka saal hai.

Dutch maahir Eugene Dubois ne 1891 mein Java ke Trinil maqam par aham fossils daryaft kiye. In baqiyat ko pehle Java Man kaha gaya aur baad mein Homo erectus mein shumar kiya gaya; daryaft ka maqam aur scientific naam alag pehlu hain.

Henri Becquerel ne 1896 mein uranium salts se khud-ba-khud nikalne wali shuaon ka mushahida kiya. Un shuaon ke photographic plate par asar ne qudrati radioactivity ki daryaft ka rasta diya; tajribay ka ansar uranium tha.

Ronald Ross ne 1897 mein machhar ke jism mein malaria parasite dekh kar machhar aur malaria ka rabta sabit kiya. Un ke kaam ne parasite ke life cycle aur bimari ki muntaqili mein machhar ka kirdar wazeh kiya; asal sabab parasite hai.

William Ramsay aur Morris Travers ne 1898 mein neon gas ko alag kar ke daryaft kiya. Neon ka naam Greek lafz neos, yani naya, se nikla hai; yeh mushtarka daryaft thi, is liye sirf Ramsay ko wahid daryaft karne wala kehna na-mukammal hai.

December 1901 mein Marconi ne Cornwall se Newfoundland tak Atlantic ke paar wireless signal ka muzahira kiya. Harf S ka signal St. John's ke Signal Hill ke qareeb receive hua; bhejne ka ilaqa aur receive hone ka maqam dono alag kinare thay.

Einstein ka special relativity ka aham maqala 1905 mein shaya hua; general relativity ki mukammal shakl taqreeban aik dahai baad samne ayi. Dono nazriyat ne space, time aur gravity ki samajh badli, magar un ke pesh hone ka marhala aik nahi.

Max Planck ko energy quantum se mutalliq kaam par 1918 ka Physics Nobel mila. Quantum energy ka muayyan packet hai; E = h nu mein nu frequency aur h Planck constant hai, is liye quantum ki energy frequency ke mutanasib hoti hai.

Alexander Fleming ne 1928 mein mould ke jaraseem-kush asar ka mushahida kiya, jis se penicillin daryaft hui. Penicillin antibiotics mein shamil hai aur bacterial infections ke khilaf istemal hoti hai; daryaft ka saal aur dawa ki qisam dono mutalliq hain.

James Chadwick ne 1932 mein neutron ki shanakht ki, jo atomic nucleus ka baghair electric charge wala zarra hai. Isi daryaft par unhein 1935 mein Physics ka Nobel Prize mila; daryaft 1932 aur inaam 1935 do alag saal hain.
Chadwick ko 1935 ka Physics Nobel neutron ki daryaft par diya gaya. Unhon ne neutron ki shanakht 1932 mein ki thi; is liye Nobel wala sawal 1935 ka jawab mangta hai, jabke discovery ka sawal 1932 ka.

Victor Hess ne 1912 mein gubbaray ke tajribaat se buland fiza mein barhti shuaon ka saboot diya, jinhein cosmic rays kaha gaya. Isi daryaft par 1936 mein unhein Physics Nobel ka nisf hissa mila; tajribay aur inaam ki tareekhein alag hain.

Neil Bartlett ne 1962 mein xenon ko platinum hexafluoride ke saath mila kar pehla tasleem shuda stable noble-gas compound tayyar kiya. Aam halat mein elemental noble gases alag alag atoms ki shakal mein hoti hain; compound banana aik mukhtalif chemical halat hai.

R. H. Whittaker ne 1969 mein jandaron ki darja bandi ke liye five-kingdom system pesh kiya. Yahan paanch kingdoms classification ke groups hain; 1969 aik khas proposed nizam ka saal hai, na ke tamam biology ki ibtida ka.

Smallpox ka aakhri qudrati taur par hone wala case 1977 mein Somalia mein record hua. Munazzam vaccination muhim ke baad World Health Assembly ne 1980 mein aalami khatmay ka elan kiya; aakhri case aur rasmi elan ke saal alag hain.

World Health Assembly ne 1980 mein smallpox ko duniya se khatam shuda qarar diya; yeh is darjay tak pohanchne wali pehli insani bimari thi. Is ka aakhri qudrati case 1977 mein Somalia mein aya tha, is liye 1980 rasmi aalami elan ka saal hai.

June 1981 mein America ke CDC ne Los Angeles ke paanch naujawan mardon ke cases ki report shaya ki. Inhein baad mein AIDS ke taur par pehchana gaya aur yeh AIDS epidemic ki pehli sarkari ittila samjhi jati hai; report America ki thi.

Institut Pasteur ki team ne 1983 mein AIDS se wabasta virus ko isolate kiya aur pehle LAV, yani lymphadenopathy-associated virus, kaha. Baad mein HIV naam apnaya gaya; virus ki pehli shanakht aur naam ki tabdeeli aik hi cheez ke marahil hain.

2014 ki Randolph Glacier Inventory mein duniya ke taqreeban 198,000 glaciers ke outlines aur naqshay shamil thay. Yeh tadaad ice sheets ko nikal kar thi aur isi inventory ka hawala hai; ise har zamane ka ghair tabdeel aalami count na samjhein.

China ka pehla azad Mars exploration mission Tianwen-1, 23 July 2020 ko launch hua. Is mein orbiter, lander aur Zhurong rover shamil thay; Tianwen-1 poore mission ka naam hai, jabke Zhurong us ke rover ka naam hai.

Riwayati Islami chronology ke mutabiq azan Hijrat ke pehle saal Madinah mein muqarrar hui. Hazrat Abdullah ibn Zayd ka khwab azan ke alfaaz se mansoob hai, jo unhon ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko sunaya; yahan saal 1 Hijri hai, 1 CE nahi.

Aam Islami tareekhi bayan zakat ke Madinah mein baqaida farz hone ko 2 Hijri se mansoob karta hai. Zakat ka salana hisaab riwayatan Hijri qamri calendar se jura hai, na ke shamsi financial year se; dono calendar ki bunyad mukhtalif hai.

Ghazwa-e-Badr Ramadan 2 Hijri mein hua, jo CE calendar mein 624 hai. Yeh ibtidai Muslim jamaat aur Makkah ke Quraysh ke darmiyan pehli bari jang thi; 2 AH aur 624 CE aik hi waqiay ko do alag calendars mein bayan karte hain.

Riwayati seerah chronology mein jang ke maani mein musallah jihad ki ijazat ya farziyat 2 Hijri se mansoob hai. Isi saal Ghazwa-e-Badr hua; yahan jihad ka hawala khaas combative sense ka hai, har maani ka aik mushtarka aghaz nahi.

Ghazwa-e-Uhud 3 Hijri mein Madinah ke shumal mein Mount Uhud ke qareeb hua. Tarteeb mein pehle Badr 2 Hijri aur phir Uhud 3 Hijri aata hai; pahaar Uhud jang ka maqami hawala hai aur qareebi shehar Madinah hai.

Khaybar ki Muslim muhim aur us ke qilon ka suqoot 7 Hijri mein hua. Khaybar aik qila-band nakhlistan tha, is liye muhim ka naam aur is ka maqam aik hi hai; yahan 7 AH ko Hijri tareekh ke taur par yaad rakhein.

Fatah-e-Makkah Ramadan 8 Hijri mein hui, jo taqreeban January 630 CE se mutabiqat rakhti hai. Seerah ke mashhoor bayan ke mutabiq taqreeban 10,000 afrad Madinah se niklay aur Makkah mehdood muzahamat aur bohat kam khoon rezi ke saath fatah hua.

Sawanehi hawalay Hazrat Khalid ibn al-Walid ke qabool-e-Islam ko 8 Hijri, yani 629 CE, mein rakhte hain. Aik hawala 1 Safar 8 Hijri ki tareekh deta hai; Hijri aur Common Era ki numbering mukhtalif hai, magar yahan waqia aik hai.

9 Hijri ke Hajj mein Hazrat Abu Bakr amir-ul-hajj thay aur Madinah se bheje gaye qaflay ki qayadat un ke paas thi. Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib ko Surah At-Tawbah ki ibtidai ayat aur mutalliq elan sunane bheja gaya; dono zimmedariyan alag thin.

Is MCQ mein naql ki gayi riwayat Hazrat Umar ibn al-Khattab ki wafat 1 Muharram 24 Hijri batati hai. Isi khas riwayat ke mutabiq mahina Muharram aur din yakum Muharram jawab hain; yeh note tamam tareekhi riwayaton ke ittefaq ka dawa nahi.

Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan teesray Rashidun khalifa thay; un ki shahadat ke baad Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib ne 35 Hijri mein chauthe khalifa ki zimmedari sambhali. Is silsilay mein pehle Uthman aur phir Ali aate hain; 35 AH aghaz-e-khilafat hai.

Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib par Kufa ki masjid mein namaz ke dauran hamla hua aur Ramadan 40 Hijri mein un ki shahadat hui. Makhaz din ki tayyun mein mukhtalif hain; is liye koi aik din qat'i batane ke bajaye mahina, saal aur shehar alag yaad rakhein.

Waqia-e-Karbala 10 Muharram 61 Hijri ko hua, jo Common Era mein 680 ka saal hai. Imam Husain aur un ke saathi Karbala mein shaheed hue; 61 AH aur 680 CE do jangon ke naam nahi balkay aik waqiay ki mukhtalif calendar tareekhein hain.

Imam Abu Hanifa ki paidaish Kufa mein hui aur sawanehi hawalay mashhoor 80 Hijri ke saath 699 CE dete hain. Yeh aik hi paidaish ko Hijri aur Common Era mein bayan karte hain; Kufa un ki jaye paidaish hai, koi kitab ka naam nahi.

Imam Malik ibn Anas ki wafat 179 Hijri mein darj hai aur unhein aham faqih ke taur par yaad kiya jata hai. Is sawal mein 179 AH wafat ka saal hai, paidaish ya kisi kitab ki ishaat ka nahi; Hijri saal ko CE ke saath mix na karein.

Rasool Allah ﷺ ki Makkah se Madinah Hijrat 622 CE mein hui. Hazrat Umar ke daur mein Hijri calendar muqarrar karte waqt isi Hijrat ke saal ko ibtidai bunyad banaya gaya; waqia-e-Hijrat aur baad mein calendar muqarrar karna alag marahil hain.

Meesaq-e-Madinah Hijrat ke baad ibtidai Madani daur, taqreeban 622 CE, se mansoob dastavez hai jo shehar ke mukhtalif girohon ke taluqaat munazzam karti thi. Islamiat mein ise written constitutional charter kaha jata hai, magar is ki jadeed qanooni darja bandi par istilahat mukhtalif hain.

Badr Ramadan 2 Hijri, yani 624 CE, mein hua. Riwayati seerah mein Muslim lashkar ki tadaad taqreeban 313 aur shaheed honay walay 14 diye gaye hain; 313 shirkat karne walon aur 14 shuhada ki tadaad hai, dono ko aik na samjhein.

Hudaybiyyah ka muahida 628 CE, yani 6 Hijri, mein Musalmanon aur Quraysh ke darmiyan hua. Quraysh ki taraf se Suhayl ibn Amr ne muzakrat kiye; muahiday ne baad ki pur-aman tabligh ke liye aham gunjaish paida ki.

630 CE ki Tabuk muhim Byzantine, yani Roomi Saltanat, ki sarhad ki simt thi. Tabuk tak fauji pesh qadmi hui lekin wahan baqaida bari maidan ki jang nahi hui; muhim ke target aur asal battlefield outcome ko alag samjhein.

Hazrat Abu Bakr pehle Rashidun khalifa thay aur un ka daur 632 se 634 CE tak taqreeban do saal raha. Un ki wafat ke baad 634 mein Hazrat Umar ibn al-Khattab ne doosray khalifa ki zimmedari sambhali; yeh dono adwar ki musalsal tartib hai.

634 CE mein Hazrat Abu Bakr ki wafat ke baad Hazrat Umar ibn al-Khattab doosray Rashidun khalifa bane. Abu Bakr ka pehla daur 632 se 634 tak tha; is liye 634 aik daur ke ikhtitam aur aglay daur ke aghaz ko jorta hai.

Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan ka daur-e-khilafat 644 se 656 CE tak taqreeban barah saal raha. Pehle chaar Rashidun khulafa mein yeh sab se lamba daur tha; aghaz 644, ikhtitam 656 aur taqreebi muddat 12 saal isi silsilay ki maloomat hain.

Mu'awiya ki qayadat mein Cyprus par pehli Arab naval raid 649 CE mein hui. Yeh Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan ki khilafat ka daur tha jab Muslim bahri quwwat munazzam ho rahi thi; fauji qayadat aur waqt ke khalifa do alag zimmedariyan hain.

656 CE mein Madinah mein baghiyon ne Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan ke ghar ka muhasra kiya aur unhein shaheed kar diya. Is waqiay ke baad pehli khana jangi shuru hui; is note mein wafat ka maqam Madinah aur tareekhi saal 656 hai.

Hazrat Ali ne siyasi aur fauji halat ki wajah se markaz-e-hukoomat Madinah se Kufa muntaqil kiya. Is sawal ki chronology Jang-e-Jamal ke baad 657 CE deti hai; asal rabta Madinah se Kufa ki taraf hukoomati markaz ki muntaqili hai.

Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib Kufa mein 661 CE mein shahadat pa gaye. Tareekhi riwayat hamlay ko Abd al-Rahman ibn Muljam se mansoob karti hai, jis ne zehr alood talwar istemal ki; shakhs Ali, maqam Kufa aur hamla awar Ibn Muljam alag pehlu hain.

680 CE ka waqia-e-Karbala Hijri calendar mein 10 Muharram 61 AH se mutabiqat rakhta hai. Imam Husain aur un ke saathi yahan shaheed hue; saal yaad karte waqt CE aur AH ke labels saath rakhein taa ke 680 aur 61 ko alag waqiat na samjha jaye.

Imam Abu Hanifa ki jaye paidaish Kufa hai aur standard sawanehi hawalay un ki paidaish taqreeban 699 CE batate hain. Isi ke saath mashhoor Hijri saal 80 AH diya jata hai; dono saal aik paidaish ki mukhtalif calendar nisbat hain.

Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz 717 CE mein Umayyad khalifa bane aur 720 tak hukoomat ki. Un ke insaf, islahat aur saadgi ki wajah se kai Muslim muarrikhin unhein riwayatan panchwan khalifa-e-rashid kehte hain; yeh laqab un ki Umayyad nisbat se alag pehlu hai.

Cairo ki Al-Azhar Mosque mein tameer ke baad Ramadan mein pehli Juma ki namaz 972 CE mein hui. Masjid baad mein ilm ka aham markaz bhi bani; is sawal mein 972 pehli Friday prayer ka hawala hai aur shehar Cairo hai.

Hulagu Khan ki qayadat mein Mongol fauj ne 1258 mein Baghdad par qabza kiya. Is se Baghdad mein qaim Abbasid khilafat ka khatma hua; yahan Mongols fauj ki pehchan, Hulagu us ki qayadat aur Baghdad hukoomati markaz tha.

Shah Wali Allah Dehlavi ne Quran ka mukammal Farsi tarjuma 1151 Hijri, yani 1738 CE, mein mukammal kiya. Yeh un ka wazeh karnaama hai; ise bila ehtiyat duniya ka sab se pehla tarjuma kehna durust nahi kyun ke pehle hone ki nisbat mutanaza hai.

Syed Ameer Ali ki kitab ka 1891 ka catalogue title The Life and Teachings of Mohammed: or, The Spirit of Islam tha. Is mein Nabi ﷺ ki zindagi aur Islami tehzeeb ke tareekhi-o-fikri pehlu hain; dono titles ko do mukhtalif authors ki kitabein na samjhein.

Pakistan ka Zakat and Ushr Ordinance 1980 mein jari hua aur is ka number XVIII of 1980 hai. Is ne sarkari satah par zakat aur ushr ke nizam ko qanooni shakal di; XVIII ordinance number hai jabke 1980 is qanoon ka saal hai.

Thomas More ne 1516 ki Latin kitab ke title ke liye Utopia lafz banaya. Is ka aam mafhoom aik khayali misali muashra ya mukammal jagah hai jo haqeeqat mein maujood na ho; kitab ka naam isi fikri tasawwur ki pehchan bana.

Arthur Conan Doyle ka A Study in Scarlet pehli baar 1887 mein shaya hua. Isi novel mein Sherlock Holmes aur Dr Watson ka taaruf hota hai; Doyle author hain jabke Holmes aur Watson novel ke kirdar hain.

Ghulam Hamadani Mushafi ke taqreeban 1780 ke kalam ko zaban ke naam Urdu ke ibtidai sabit shuda istemal mein shumar kiya jata hai. Is se pehle Urdu shaeri ke liye Rekhta naam aam tha; yeh naam ki tareekh hai, zaban ke achanak paida hone ka dawa nahi.

Mirza Ghalib 1797 mein paida hue aur 15 February 1869 ko un ka inteqal hua. Un ki zindagi ka mukhtasar chronological daira 1797 se 1869 hai; paidaish aur wafat ke sawalon mein in dono siron ko ulatne se bachein.

British colonial intizam mein 1837 ke Act No. 29 ne adalaton mein Farsi ki lazmi haisiyat khatam kar ke maqami zabanon ki gunjaish di. Shumali Hindustan ki kai adalaton mein Urdu ya Hindustani ka istemal barha; yeh har ilaqay mein aik hi zaban lazim karne ka bayan nahi.

Altaf Husain Hali 1837 mein paida hue, jabke Muhammad Husain Azad ki paidaish 1830 mein hui thi. Hali is hisaab se Azad se saat saal chhotay hum-asr thay; junior contemporary se murad yahan umar ka farq hai, adabi darjay ka nahi.

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan ki Asar-us-Sanadid Delhi ki tareekhi imaraton, asar aur shehri zindagi ki dastavez hai. Pehla edition 1847 mein aur nazar sani shuda doosra edition 1854 mein aya; pehli ishaat aur revised edition ke saal alag hain.

Deputy Nazir Ahmad ki Mirat-ul-Uroos 1869 mein shaya hui aur Urdu novel ki ibtidai asar angez misaalon mein shumar hoti hai. Isi nisbat se unhein aam tor par pehla Urdu novelist kaha jata hai; kitab, author aur saal isi adabi sang-e-meel se jurtay hain.

Mirza Ghalib ka inteqal 15 February 1869 ko hua; un ki paidaish ka saal 1797 tha. Is liye 1797 zindagi ka aghaz aur 1869 ikhtitam hai; wafat ki mukammal tareekh aur dono saalon ki tartib aik saath yaad rakhein.

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan ne Tahzeeb-ul-Akhlaq ka pehla shumara December 1870 mein jari kiya. Yeh Musalmanon ki samaji, taleemi aur fikri islah ka risala tha aur Aligarh Tehreek ka aham platform bana; yeh shaeri ka majmua nahi.

Anjuman-e-Punjab ke naye tarz ke mauzuati aur islahi Urdu mushairay 1874 mein shuru hue. Colonial education official Colonel W. R. M. Holroyd ne in ki hausla afzai aur sarparasti ki; is sawal mein un ki pehchan patron ki hai.

Awadh Punch 1877 mein Lucknow se shuru hone wala Urdu ka tanziya haftawar risala tha. Munshi Sajjad Husain is ke bani aur pehle editor thay; risalay ke shehar, saal aur mudir ko Urdu tanz-o-mazah ke isi silsilay se jorein.

Mirza Hadi Ruswa ka Umrao Jaan Ada pehli baar 1899 mein shaya hua aur Urdu fiction ka aham classic bana. Novel ka markazi mahaul unnisween sadi ka Lucknow hai; 1899 kitab ki ishaat hai, kahani ke har waqiay ki tareekh nahi.

Urdu mahnama Makhzan April 1901 mein Lahore se shaya hona shuru hua. Mukhtalif MCQs isi aghaz ka saal, mahina ya shehar poochte hain; mukammal rabta Makhzan, Lahore aur April 1901 hai, teen alag publications nahi.

Urdu ke mazah nigar Shaukat Thanvi 1904 mein paida hue aur un ka inteqal 4 May 1963 ko hua. Swadeshi Rail un ki mashhoor tanziya tehreer hai; 1904–1963 un ki zindagi ka daira aur kitab un ki adabi pehchan batati hai.

Allama Iqbal ki Ilm-ul-Iqtisad pehli baar 1904 mein shaya hui aur Urdu mein un ki pehli baqaida nasri tasneef samjhi jati hai. Kitab maashiyat ke bunyadi mabahis par hai; isay Iqbal ke shaeri majmuon ke bajaye nasri kaam mein rakhein.

Allama Iqbal 1905 se 1908 tak Europe mein rahe aur aala taleem hasil ki; un ki philosophy doctorate University of Munich se thi. Yahan 1905 European taleemi daur ka aghaz aur 1908 us arsay ka ikhtitam hai, doctorate milne ki alag tareekh nahi di ja rahi.

Muhammad Husain Azad ne zindagi ka bara hissa Lahore mein guzara aur 1910 mein wahin wafat pai. Un ki mashhoor kitab Aab-e-Hayat Urdu shaeri aur shuara ki tareekhi riwayat bayan karti hai; Lahore wafat ka shehar aur Aab-e-Hayat tasneef hai.

Iqbal ki pehli Farsi masnavi Asrar-i-Khudi 1915 mein samne ayi. Is title ka mashhoor English tarjuma The Secrets of the Self hai: Asrar secrets aur Khudi self ko zahir karta hai; zaban Farsi aur saal 1915 hai.

Bang-e-Dara 1924 mein shaya hua aur Allama Iqbal ka pehla Urdu shaeri majmua hai. Is mein un ki ibtidai aur darmiyani adwar ki nazmein jama hain; majmuay ki ishaat ka saal har nazm ke likhe jane ka saal nahi hota.

Iqbal ka Farsi shaeri majmua Zabur-e-Ajam 1927 mein pehli baar shaya hua. Is ka aam English title Persian Psalms hai aur is mein khudi, roohaniyat aur ijtimai bedari ke mauzu milte hain; ise Urdu majmuay ke bajaye Farsi kaam samjhein.

Mahnama Adabi Duniya May 1929 mein Lahore se jari hua. Maulana Salahuddin Ahmad ki is risalay se editor ke taur par wabastagi thi; risalay ka aghaz, shehar aur un ki idarti pehchan isi adabi silsilay ke alag pehlu hain.

1932 ke Urdu majmuay Angarey ke chaar contributors Sajjad Zaheer, Ahmed Ali, Mahmud-uz-Zafar aur Rashid Jahan thay. Rashid Jahan in mein wahid khatoon thin aur unhon ne khawateen ki zindagi aur samaji pabandiyon ko afsanay aur dramay ka mauzu banaya.

Urdu mahnama Adab-e-Latif ka pehla shumara March 1935 mein Lahore se shaya hua. Is pehle shumaray ko Talib Ansari ne tarteeb diya tha; first issue ke compiler, magazine ka naam aur ishaat ki tareekh ko isi khas marhalay se jorein.

Bal-e-Jibril ka pehla edition 1935 mein shaya hua aur yeh Allama Iqbal ka aham Urdu shaeri majmua hai. Is mein Urdu nazmein aur ghazlein hain; isay nasri kitab ya Farsi majmuay ke bajaye Urdu poetry collection ke taur par pehchanein.

All-India Progressive Writers' Association 1936 mein munazzam hui aur us ka pehla conference Lucknow mein Premchand ki sadarat mein hua. Tehreek ne taraqqi pasand adab, samaji haqeeqat nigari aur nau-abadiyati mukhalifat ko farogh diya.

Faiz Ahmad Faiz ka pehla shaya shuda shaeri majmua Naqsh-e-Faryadi 1941 mein aya. Is ne un ki ibtidai roomani aur inqalabi shaeri ko jama kiya; pehle collection ka title aur saal 1941 un ki adabi ibtida ke mutalliq hain.

Urdu shair Meeraji ka inteqal 1949 mein Bombay, yani maujooda Mumbai, mein hua. Bombay aur Mumbai isi shehar ke naam hain; purane naam se sawal aaye ya naye naam se, wafat ke shehar ki pehchan aik hi rahegi.

Soviet Union ne Faiz Ahmed Faiz ko adab aur aman ki khidmaat par 1962 mein Lenin Peace Prize diya. Woh Progressive Writers' Movement ke numayan shair thay aur 20 November 1984 ko Lahore mein wafat pai; inaam aur wafat ki tareekhein alag hain.

Shaukat Thanvi 1904 mein paida hue aur 4 May 1963 ko wafat pa gaye. Swadeshi Rail un ki mashhoor tanziya tehreer hai; paidaish 1904 aur wafat 1963 un ki zindagi ka daira batati hain, jabke kitab un ki mazahiya pehchan hai.

Kamal Ahmed Rizvi ne Alif Noon pehli martaba 1965 mein television ke liye likha. Woh is comedy series ke creator aur writer honay ke saath Allan ka kirdar bhi ada karte thay; likhne aur acting ki dono nisbat aik hi shakhs se hai.

Intizar Husain ka afsanon ka majmua Aakhri Aadmi pehli baar Lahore se 1967 mein shaya hua. Is mein Hijrat, tehzeebi yad-dasht aur zawal jaisay mauzu milte hain; yeh short-story collection hai, kisi shakhs ki sawaneh nahi.

Tarar ke shaya shuda interviews ke mutabiq Niklay Teri Talash Mein un ka pehla safarnama tha jo 1971 mein kitab bana. Unhon ne Pyar Ka Pehla Shehr ko pehla novel kaha; safarnamay aur novel ki pehli kitab ko aik samajhna ghalat hoga.

Colonel Muhammad Khan ka Ba-Salamat Ravi pehli baar 1975 mein shaya hua aur ise un ki doosri kitab bhi kaha jata hai. Yeh mazahiya safarnama hai jis mein bairun-e-mulk mushahidat shagufta aur tanziya nasr mein bayan hue hain.

Parveen Shakir ka pehla shaeri majmua Khushbu 1976 mein shaya hua. Is ki ishaat se unhein wasee shohrat mili aur jadeed Urdu shaeri mein un ki pehchan mazboot hui; title Khushbu, author Parveen Shakir aur saal 1976 hai.

Insan Aur Aadmi Muhammad Hasan Askari ki kitab hai aur diye gaye bibliographic record mein is edition ka saal 1976 darj hai. Edition ki tareekh ko author ki paidaish, wafat ya kisi doosri kitab ki ishaat se alag samjhein.

Faiz Ahmed Faiz 20 November 1984 ko Lahore mein wafat pa gaye. Unhein is se pehle 1962 mein Soviet Union ne adab aur aman ki khidmaat par Lenin Peace Prize diya tha; 1962 inaam aur 1984 wafat ka saal hai.

Bharat ki hukoomat ne Kaleem Ahmad Aajiz ko 1989 mein adabi khidmaat par Padma Shri diya. Daman pe koi chheent na khanjar pe koi daagh se shuru hone wala mashhoor sher bhi un se mansoob hai; shair aur inaam ke saal ko saath jorein.

Muqtadara Qaumi Zaban ka pehla English naam National Language Authority tha. 6 July 2015 ko ise National Language Promotion Department ki surat mein dobara munazzam kiya gaya; purana aur naya naam isi idaray ki mukhtalif intizami shaklein hain.

Federal Tax Ombudsman ka daftar Establishment of the Office of Federal Tax Ombudsman Ordinance, 2000 ke tehat qaim hua. Mushtaq Sukhera baad mein 8 September 2017 se 29 September 2021 tak is ohday par rahe; idaray ka qayam aur shakhs ki muddat alag hain.

Mushtaq Sukhera ne 8 September 2017 ko Federal Tax Ombudsman ki zimmedari sambhali aur 29 September 2021 tak rahe. Is daftar ki qanooni bunyad 2000 ka ordinance tha; ohday ki apni tareekh aur kisi fard ka tenure aik cheez nahi.

Maujooda sawal ka paper-date record 7 June 2026 ko section 16C ki had 90 feesad batata hai aur 1 July 2026 ki tabdeeli ke liye 80 feesad deta hai. Yeh sawal ke tareekhi context ki wazahat hai, aaj ke qanoon ki tasdeeq ya zaati tax mashwara nahi.

Victor Hess ne 1912 mein gubbaray ke tajribaat se buland fiza mein barhti radiation ka saboot diya, jo cosmic rays ki daryaft se mansoob hai. Unhein is kaam par Physics Nobel 1936 mein mila; 1912 discovery aur 1936 award ka saal hai.

Charles Darwin ne 1859 mein On the Origin of Species shaya kar ke natural selection se evolution ki tafseeli wazahat ki. Is se pehle 1858 mein Darwin aur Alfred Russel Wallace ki tehreerain mushtarka pesh hui thin; Wallace ne bhi khayal azadana nikala tha.

Paul Villard ne 1900 mein radium se nikalne wali zyada andar tak guzarne ki salahiyat wali radiation pehchani. Ernest Rutherford ne baad mein ise gamma rays ka naam diya; discoverer Villard aur naam dene wale Rutherford ko alag yaad rakhein.

Igor Sikorsky ke VS-300 ne 1939 mein successful flight ki aur practical single-rotor helicopter ki taraqqi ka rasta khola. Baad ka R-4 pehla mass-produced helicopter bana; experimental design VS-300 aur production model R-4 alag marahil hain.

Dennis Ritchie ne Bell Labs mein 1971 se 1973 ke dauran Ken Thompson ki B language ko taraqqi de kar C banayi. Data types aur doosri tabdeeliyon ke saath unhon ne compiler likha; C ne Unix ko mukhtalif machines par muntaqil karne mein madad di.

John Blankenbaker ka Kenbak-1 1971 mein farokht ke liye pesh hua aur Computer History Museum ise earliest personal computer ke taur par pehchanta hai. Yeh microprocessor se pehle ka design tha aur is mein 256 bytes memory thi; Kenbak-1 model ka naam hai.

Tim Berners-Lee ne CERN mein 1989 mein World Wide Web ki tajweez pesh ki. Web pages, URLs aur HTTP se maloomat ko baham jorne wala yeh nizam tha; CERN research idara, Berners-Lee mojad aur WWW un ki ijad ka naam hai.

Makran Pakistan ki janubi sahili patti ke maghribi hissay mein Bahira-e-Arab ke saath waqia hai. Mutalliq mausamiyati hawala 1945 ke Makran tsunami ka zikr karta hai; tareekh ke saath sahil Makran aur samandar Bahira-e-Arab ka rabta yaad rakhein.

Mortimer Durand ne 1893 mein Afghan Amir Abdur Rahman Khan ke saath hadbandi ke muzakrat kiye aur Durand Line ka naam isi nisbat se aya. Yeh Pakistan-Afghanistan sarhad ka aam naam hai; ise 1947 ki taqseem se mutalliq Radcliffe Line se na milayein.

Charles Babbage 1791 mein London mein paida hue aur Britain mein riyazi aur machine saazi par kaam kiya. Woh Analytical Engine ke designer thay; paidaish ke shehar London aur un ki qaumi nisbat Britain ko mukhtalif sawalon ke jawab samjhein.

John Atanasoff ne apne talib-e-ilm Clifford Berry ke saath 1939 se 1942 ke dauran Atanasoff-Berry Computer, yani ABC, banaya. Yeh Iowa State College mein tayyar hua, jo ab Iowa State University hai; dono names aik hi idaray ke hawalay hain.

Pehla UNIVAC I 1951 mein America ke U.S. Census Bureau ko diya gaya. UNIVAC ka poora naam Universal Automatic Computer hai, jo aam automatic data processing ko zahir karta hai; machine ka naam aur ise hasil karne wala idara alag hain.

John Bardeen, William Shockley aur Walter Brattain ko semiconductor research aur transistor effect par 1956 ka Nobel mila. Working point-contact transistor Bardeen aur Brattain ne 1947 mein banaya tha; pehla muzahira aur mushtarka inaam alag marahil hain.

Dartmouth College ke John Kemeny aur Thomas Kurtz ne 1964 mein BASIC system istemal ke liye pesh kiya. BASIC ka poora naam Beginners' All-purpose Symbolic Instruction Code hai; yeh beginners ki programming language hai, hardware ya course nahi.

Guido van Rossum ki banayi hui Python ki pehli public release 1991 mein hui. Is ka naam saanp par nahi balkay BBC comedy show Monty Python's Flying Circus se liya gaya; language ka creator aur naam ki wajah do mutalliq facts hain.

Digital Equipment Corporation ke researchers ne AltaVista search engine tayyar kiya aur 1995 mein jari kiya. Muqablay mein Yahoo ki ibtida 1994 ki hai; jab earliest service poochi jaye to company ka naam hi nahi balkay launch ki tartib bhi dekhein.

Isaac Newton ne 1687 mein Principia Mathematica mein harkat ke qawaneen aur universal gravitation pesh ki. Kitab ka mukammal naam Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica hai; author Newton aur gravity ka riyazi qanoon isi kaam se mansoob hain.

Benjamin Franklin ne machhli aur mehman ki mashhoor kahawat 1736 ke Poor Richard's Almanack mein shaya ki. Is mein mazahiya taur par teen din ka zikr hai; yeh samaji kahawat hai, koi scientific muddat ya haqeeqi sehat ka qanoon nahi.

Munshi Nawal Kishore ne 1858 mein Lucknow mein Nawal Kishore Press qaim ki. Press ne Quran-e-Majid ke mutaddid nuskhay bhi chap kar wasee qarieen tak pohanchaye; Nawal Kishore shakhs, press idara aur Lucknow qayam ka shehar hai.

Bahadur Shah II ne shaeri mein Zafar takhallus apnaya aur Bahadur Shah Zafar ke naam se mashhoor hue. Woh aakhri Mughal badshah thay; 1857 ki baghawat ke baad un ki maazooli aur Mughal hukoomat ka khatma isi aakhri daur se wabasta hai.

Jane Austen ka Sense and Sensibility 1811 mein shaya hua aur un ki zindagi mein chapne wala pehla novel tha. Ibtidai ishaat mein author ki pehchan By a Lady likhi gayi thi; ghair naamzad ishaat ke bawajood tasneef Austen hi ki hai.

McMahon Line 1913–1914 ke Simla muzakrat ke dauran naqshay par tay hone wali hadbandi thi. Yeh India aur China ke mashriqi Himalayan sarhadi tanazay se mutalliq hai; conference Simla tha aur do mulkon ka hawala India-China hai.

French doctor Rene Laennec ne 1816 mein stethoscope ijad kiya. Yahan sawal shakhs, tibbi aala aur ijad ke saal ko jorta hai: Laennec mojad hain, stethoscope instrument hai aur 1816 isi aale ki ijad se mansoob saal hai.

George Bernard Shaw 1856 mein Dublin, Ireland mein paida hue aur baad mein London chale gaye. Un ka tanziya drama Arms and the Man jang aur roomani bahaduri ke riwayati tasawwur par tanqeed karta hai; Dublin jaye paidaish hai.

Leo Baekeland ne 1907 mein phenol aur formaldehyde se Bakelite tayyar ki, jise pehla mukammal synthetic plastic kaha jata hai. Is ke baraks celluloid qudrati cellulose mein chemical tabdeeli se banta tha, is liye fully synthetic ki shart aham hai.

Arfa Karim ne 2004 mein sirf nau saal ki umar mein Microsoft Certified Professional certification hasil ki. Un ki bain-ul-aqwami pehchan information technology se bani; yahan nau saal un ki umar hai aur 2004 certification ka saal.

Abdullah Hussain ka novel Udas Naslain pehli baar 1963 mein shaya hua aur bar-e-sagheer ki tareekh aur insani tajribay ko wasee pasmanzar mein pesh karta hai. Decade poochne par 1960s aur exact year poochne par 1963 durust jawab hai.

Ahmad Nadeem Qasmi ne Urdu adabi risalay Funoon ki bunyad rakhi, jo 1963 mein Lahore se shuru hua. Woh is ke founding editor thay aur arsay tak mudir rahe; saal 1963 ko decade ki surat mein 1960s kaha jata hai.

Israel ne 1967 ki jang mein Golan Heights par qabza kiya. Aqwam-e-Muttahida is ilaqay ke liye Occupied Syrian Golan ki istilah istemal karti hai, jo Syrian nisbat aur Israeli qabzay ka farq wazeh karti hai; tanaza Syria aur Israel se mutalliq hai.

Dakhni shair Nusrati ki Ali Nama taqreeban 1665 ki razmiya masnavi hai aur use Urdu ki ibtidai mukammal epics mein bayan kiya jata hai. 1665 satrahween sadi mein aata hai; is liye century wala jawab 17th century hai.

Muhammad Husain Azad 1830 mein paida hue aur 1910 mein Lahore mein wafat pai. Hali ki paidaish 1837 ki hai, is liye Azad umar mein un se saat saal baray thay; paidaish ki tartib se junior contemporary wala sawal samajh aata hai.

Sultan Bahu ki zindagi 1630 se 1691 tak rahi aur is daur mein woh Shah Jahan aur Aurangzeb dono ke adwar mein zinda thay. Un ki mashhoor kafiyan Punjabi mein hain; do hukmaranon se hum-asri aur shaeri ki zaban alag sawalon ke pehlu hain.

Sultan Bahu 1630 mein paida hue aur 1691 mein un ki zindagi ka ikhtitam hua. Un ki zindagi Shah Jahan aur Aurangzeb dono ke adwar ko chhooti hai, is liye sirf aik badshah tak mehdood jawab na dein; un ki kafiyan Punjabi mein mashhoor hain.

Panipat ki teen bari jangon ki tartib 1526, 1556 aur 1761 hai; 1526 pehli jang ka saal hai. Panipat Delhi ke shumal mein Bharat ki Haryana riyasat ka shehar hai; aik hi maqam par mukhtalif adwar ki jangon ko alag pehchanein.

Panipat ki doosri mashhoor jang 1556 mein hui; pehli 1526 aur teesri 1761 ki hai. Maqam Panipat maujooda Haryana, India mein hai; same shehar ke naam se hone wali in teen jangon ki chronological tartib alag rakhna zaroori hai.

Panipat ki teesri bari jang 1761 mein hui, jabke pehli do 1526 aur 1556 mein thin. Panipat Haryana ka tareekhi shehar hai; teen jangon ka count aur un ke saalon ka silsila aik doosray ko yaad rakhne mein madad deta hai.

Al-Walid ibn Abd al-Malik chhatay Umayyad khalifa thay aur un ka daur 705 se 715 CE tak raha. Muhammad bin Qasim ki Sindh muhim isi daur mein hui, jabke Iraq ke governor Al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf ne muhim ko munazzam aur direct kiya.

Jane Austen ka doosra shaya shuda novel Pride and Prejudice 1813 mein aya. Ibtidai maswada First Impressions ke title se tha aur nazar sani ke dauran naya naam mila; dono titles isi novel ki tayyari ke mukhtalif marahil hain.

Thomas Montgomerie ne 1856 ke Great Trigonometrical Survey mein door se nazar anay wali Karakoram chotiyon ko K1 aur K2 ke aarzi number diye. K ka matlab Karakoram tha; yeh survey designation ki tareekh hai, choti par pehli chadhai ka saal nahi.

Abbasid khalifa Al-Mansur ne 762 CE mein Baghdad ki bunyad rakhi aur ise naya dar-ul-hukumat banaya. Is se pehle Umayyad hukoomat ka markaz Damascus tha; shehar Baghdad, bani Al-Mansur aur Abbasid siyasi daur ko saath jorein.

Damascus 661 se 750 CE tak Umayyad khilafat ka dar-ul-hukumat raha. Barada darya shehar se guzarta hai aur tareekhi taur par pani deta raha; hukoomati daur ka aghaz-o-ikhtitam aur darya ki pehchan isi shehar ke mutalliq hain.
